description: Edit existing flashcard content (concept, question, answer, hint, visual hints, tags, image, difficulty). Updates are saved to database and cache is invalidated. Free (no coin cost). Requires authentication and ownership.

flashcard_id.description: UUID from 'data.items[].id' in create_flashcards response (mode 1). Use this OR set_id+sequence, not both. MUST be from actual response.

sequence.description: Card number within set (1-based). Requires set_id parameter.

set_id.description: The flashcard_set_id from create_flashcards response (e.g., 'cache_xxx_yyy') (mode 2). Requires sequence parameter.

name: edit_flashcards
title: Edit Flashcards
